the hybrid recommendation system with interactive visual explanations outperforms other recommendation approaches in terms of user satisfaction and relevance.

1) hybrid recommender systems that combine multiple data sources are effective at generating recommendations, 2) interactive hybrid systems that explain the recommendation process are preferred by users over traditional systems, and 3) interactive hybrid systems can be designed to be more effective at predicting relevant recommendations than non-interactive hybrid systems.
